08:49:16   host: jenkins@mwperf-server13.perf.lab.eng.rdu2.redhat.com:22{noformat}

Some dependencies are problematic:

* de.huxhorn.sulky:de.huxhorn.sulky.ulid:jar:8.3.0 - seems to be a single class and wring weird dependencies (including JRuby components)
* net.thisptr:jackson-jq:jar:1.6.2 -  problematic because of Jackson 3 coming and this could be a CVE nest
* net.thisptr:jackson-jq-extra:jar:1.6.1 - wrong alignment 
* io.quarkus:quarkus-proxy-registry:jar:3.33.2 - I’m not sure it’s productized 

Also, for langchain4j:

* Our Quarkus Agentic support is not ready to be “stable”, so it means that Quarkus Flow Langchain4J should probably be TP

For persistence, we cannot support all your providers. I believe focusing on Hibernate right now is enough.
